zh-CN: 修复黑夜与暮光主题下主题选择菜单白底浅色文字、选项难以辨认的问题。
主题下拉选项现在同时使用当前主题的字段背景和正文色，浅色主题也保持一致。
en-US: Fixes low-contrast theme menu options that appeared as light text on a white popup in Night and Twilight.
Theme options now use the active theme's field background and primary text color across both dark and light themes.
